response: Socioeconomic status does matter when it comes to the learning needs of postpartum women. It is essential to ensure that new mothers, especially those of low socioeconomic status, have access to accessible and appropriate community-based information resources during the postpartum period. This is crucial in addressing their specific learning needs and providing them with adequate information on topics important to them. By doing so, we can help bridge the gap in healthcare knowledge and support among women of different socioeconomic backgrounds, ultimately improving their overall health and well-being.
